items.source: The standard starter connects simultaneously to one or more MCP servers over STDIO (in-process), SSE, Streamable-HTTP and Stateless Streamable-HTTP transports. The SSE and Streamable-Http transports use the JDK HttpClient-based transport implementation. Each connection to an MCP server creates a new MCP client instance. You can choose either SYNC or ASYNC MCP clients (note: you cannot mix sync and async clients). For production deployment, we recommend using the WebFlux-based SSE & StreamableHttp connection with the spring-ai-starter-mcp-client-webflux.
items.translation: 标准启动器可同时通过 `STDIO`（进程内）、`SSE`、`Streamable-HTTP` 和 `Stateless Streamable-HTTP` 传输协议连接到一台或多台 MCP 服务器。 SSE 和 Streamable-Http 传输使用基于 JDK HttpClient 的传输实现。 每次与 MCP 服务器的连接都会创建一个新的 MCP 客户端实例。 您可以选择 `SYNC` 或 `ASYNC` 类型的 MCP 客户端（注意：不能混合使用同步和异步客户端）。 对于生产环境部署，我们建议使用基于 WebFlux 的 SSE 及 StreamableHttp 连接，并配合使用 `spring-ai-starter-mcp-client-webflux`。

items.source: Custom Sampling Handlers - standardized way for servers to request LLM sampling (completions or generations) from LLMs via clients. This flow allows clients to maintain control over model access, selection, and permissions while enabling servers to leverage AI capabilities — with no server API keys necessary.
items.translation: 自定义采样处理器——一种标准化的方式，允许服务器通过客户端向大语言模型请求采样（completions 或 generations）。该流程使客户端能够保持对模型访问、选择及权限的控制，同时让服务器利用人工智能能力，而无需任何服务器 API 密钥。

items.source: File system (Roots) Access - standardized way for clients to expose filesystem roots to servers. Roots define the boundaries of where servers can operate within the filesystem, allowing them to understand which directories and files they have access to. Servers can request the list of roots from supporting clients and receive notifications when that list changes.
items.translation: 文件系统（根目录）访问 - 一种标准化的方式，供客户端向服务器暴露文件系统的 roots。 根目录定义了服务器在文件系统中可操作的边界，使其能够了解可以访问哪些目录和文件。 服务器可以从支持该功能的客户端请求根目录列表，并在该列表发生变化时接收通知。

items.source: The MCP Client Boot Starter supports customizable tool name prefix generation through the McpToolNamePrefixGenerator interface. This feature helps avoid naming conflicts when integrating tools from multiple MCP servers by adding unique prefixes to tool names.

items.translation: initializeResult - 来自 MCP 服务器的初始化结果，包含服务器信息

items.source:
The Spring AI MCP (Model Context Protocol) Client Boot Starter provides auto-configuration for MCP client functionality in Spring Boot applications.
It supports both synchronous and asynchronous client implementations with various transport options.
items.translation: Spring AI MCP（模型上下文协议）客户端启动器为 Spring Boot 应用程序中的 MCP 客户端功能提供自动配置支持。它支持同步和异步客户端实现，并提供多种传输选项。

items.source: The MCP Client Boot Starter provides:
items.translation: MCP 客户端启动器提供：

items.source: Management of multiple client instances
items.translation: 多客户端实例的管理

items.source: Automatic client initialization (if enabled)
items.translation: 自动客户端初始化（如已启用）

items.source: Support for multiple named transports (STDIO, Http/SSE and Streamable HTTP)
items.translation: 支持多种命名传输方式（STDIO、Http/SSE 和流式 HTTP）

items.source: Integration with Spring AI’s tool execution framework
items.translation: 与 Spring AI 工具执行框架的集成

items.source: Tool filtering capabilities for selective tool inclusion/exclusion
items.translation: 支持选择性包含/排除工具的过滤功能

items.source: Customizable tool name prefix generation for avoiding naming conflicts
items.translation: 用于避免命名冲突的可自定义工具名称前缀生成

items.source: Proper lifecycle management with automatic cleanup of resources when the application context is closed
items.translation: 实现正确的生命周期管理，并在应用程序上下文关闭时自动清理资源。

items.source: Customizable client creation through customizers
items.translation: 通过自定义器创建可定制的客户端

items.source: The auto-configuration provides extensive client spec customization capabilities through callback interfaces. These customizers allow you to configure various aspects of the MCP client behavior, from request timeouts to event handling and message processing.

items.translation: 可用以下自定义选项：

items.source: Tools change notifications - when the list of available server tools changes

items.source: Resources change notifications - when the list of available server resources changes.
items.translation: 资源变更通知——当可用服务器资源列表发生变化时。

items.source: Prompts change notifications - when the list of available server prompts changes.
items.translation: 服务器提示符变更通知——当可用服务器提示符列表发生变化时。

items.source: Clients can control logging verbosity by setting minimum log levels
items.translation: 客户端可以通过设置最低日志级别来控制日志的详细程度。

items.source: The MCP client auto-configuration automatically detects and applies any customizers found in the application context.
items.translation: MCP 客户端自动配置会自动检测并应用应用程序上下文中发现的任何自定义器。

items.source: The auto-configuration supports multiple transport types:
items.translation: 自动配置支持多种传输类型：

items.source:
The filter is automatically detected and applied to both synchronous and asynchronous MCP tool callback providers.
If no custom filter is provided, all discovered tools are included by default.
items.translation:
过滤器会自动检测并应用于同步和异步的 MCP 工具回调提供者。  
如果未提供自定义过滤器，则默认包含所有发现的工具。

items.source: Tracks all existing connections and tool names to ensure uniqueness
items.translation: 跟踪所有现有连接和工具名称，以确保其唯一性。

items.source: Is thread-safe and maintains idempotency - the same combination of (client, server, tool) always gets the same unique name
items.translation: 线程安全且保持幂等性——（客户端、服务器、工具）的任意组合始终生成相同的唯一名称。

items.source: Ensures the final name doesn’t exceed 64 characters (truncating from the beginning if necessary)
items.translation: 确保最终名称不超过 64 个字符（必要时从开头截断）
